qualifiers.condition: KPL aggregation on a Kinesis data stream that is the Firehose source

evidence.quote: If you use the Kinesis Producer Library (KPL) to write data to a Kinesis data stream, you can use aggregation to combine the records that you write to that Kinesis data stream.

If you then use that data stream as a source for your Firehose stream, Amazon Data Firehose de-aggregates the records before it delivers them to the destination. If you configure your Firehose stream to transform the data, Amazon Data Firehose de-aggregates the records before it delivers them to AWS Lambda.
